_help: Screenshots the model still needs, asked ONE at a time as a step in `next` (once each; `done` marks it seen). Add items here whenever a screen is needed. id, where (the menu path), show (what must be visible), why. Items with repeat=true come back on an interval that ADAPTS: after sending the screen run `done --changed` (it differed from last time: asked sooner) or `done --same` (asked less often). base_h/min_h/max_h are the starting, fastest and slowest intervals in hours. 'moves': the screen is also due when you are this many jumps from where its list was last scanned (lists like Freelance Jobs show what is near YOU).
